messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2245 — Elevated p95/p99 latency and sporadic 5xxs in EU region (hosted API). Paging @tim.ong (on-call).

tim.ong: I'm on it. seeing alerts for p99 tokens latency spike ~350ms above normal. grabbing dashboard. // which routes?

mike.sre: looks like smart-routing is aggressively favoring premium/low-latency lanes for EU, those pools are hitting queue depth. economy lane healthy. spikes started at 2245003000.

kate.ops: Customer-facing metric: some customers report increased tail latency and a couple of request timeouts. I've opened a short support note to affected customers. no full outage.

alice.prod: Confirmed 3 customers with errors (500). Two of them are using long-context models on economy fallback which is weird. Logs show backend timeouts from the premium pool.

mike.sre: hypothesis: steering weight algorithm pushed more sessions to premium after recent canary; premium pool can't sustain bursty session mix. We should reduce steering pressure and add emergency rate-limits on the premium tier.

liaison.devex: tagging product and docs for any public comms. small ask: what's expected customer impact if we throttle premium by 20%?

mike.sre: estimate: latency should normalize for most traffic; a small fraction of low-latency customers will see increased latency (move to secondary). 5xxs should drop quickly.
\

kate.ops: proposed immediate actions (live mitigation):
1) Apply emergency steering change: reduce priority->premium weight by 25% for EU, shift to eu-secondary.
2) Apply short-lived rate-limit on premium route for free-tier and economy-tier customers to protect premium capacity.
3) Disable long-context model routing for economy fallback to avoid extra KV cache pressure.
4) Monitor errors for 10m and iterate.
\

mike.sre: I'm going to execute 1 and 2. Handing off to me after this message. @tim.ong standby for on-call handoff if needed.
\

mike.sre: running command to adjust steering weights now:
```bash
# reduce weight from premium pool and shift to secondary
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/steer" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"eu","from":"premium","to":"secondary","shift_percent":25,"reason":"emergency-latency-mitigation"}'
```

mike.sre: applying rate-limit rule for premium routes (10rps per key burst 20) for 15m:
```json
{
  "action": "rate_limit",
  "scope": "route:premium",
  "limit": "10rps",
  "burst": 20,
  "duration": "15m",
  "tag": "emergency-2245"
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for routing-change (deployment id: deplo-2245-01). Estimated 8s.
\

deploy-bot: routing-change applied in eu region. rollout: 100% -> success.
\

mike.sre: steering change confirmed. metrics: p99 down ~180ms within 90s, error rate dropping. continuing to monitor.
\

tim.ong: taking primary on-call. I'll keep watch for 30m then rotate. assigning follow-ups: create an incident card and post a short customer-impact summary.
\

kate.ops: customer update draft: "We've applied a short-lived routing change to improve latency in the EU region; some customers may see modest changes in latency while we rebalance traffic. We're monitoring and will follow up." want to send after stabilization.
\

alice.prod: noticed a small bump in CPU on the eu-secondary nodes after shift. not alarming yet. watching KV cache evictions.
\

mike.sre: disabling long-context model routing for economy fallback now to reduce memory pressure:
```bash
# toggle model-routing flag for economy fallback
rlctl feature-toggle set --name economy_long_context_routing --value false --env prod --region eu
```
\

mike.sre: flag flipped. will keep it off for 1h and reassess.
\

tim.ong: summary of mitigation steps taken: steering weight -25% -> secondary, emergency rate-limit on premium (15m), disabled economy long-context routing, monitoring p99/errors. no rollback of canary yet.
\

liaison.devex: tagging docs to capture runbook steps so on-call next time can do this faster: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/smart-routing-emergency
\

kate.ops: error rate back down to normal baseline after ~6m. p99 stabilized near acceptable threshold. sending customer note now.
\

kate.ops: customer note sent to affected customers. kept wording conservative and offered a follow-up incident report.
\

mike.sre: leaving mitigation in place for 30m while we watch. if stable, we'll gradually revert steering weight and remove rate-limit in controlled steps (10% per 5m).
\

tim.ong: acknowledging. if we see queue depth growth again, next step is to spin up extra premium capacity or throttle specific model families more aggressively.
\

mike.sre: creating follow-up tasks: ticket #INC-2245-POSTMORTEM (owner: mike.sre), add load tests for priority steering algorithm, evaluate canary traffic spike handling.
\

liaison.devex: I'll coordinate a postmortem and link to incident card.
\

tim.ong: thanks everyone. handing back to normal ops at 2245004480. closing paging loop. :white_check_mark:
